name: recall
description: A fast desktop SQL client — Electrobun + Vue

scripts.start: hutch electrobun prepare && hutch pm exec -- vite build && hutch electrobun dev
scripts.dev: hutch electrobun prepare && hutch pm exec -- vite build && hutch electrobun dev --watch
scripts.dev:hmr: hutch pm exec -- concurrently "hutch run hmr" "hutch run start"
scripts.hmr: hutch electrobun prepare && hutch pm exec -- vite --port 5173
scripts.build: hutch electrobun prepare && hutch pm exec -- vite build && hutch electrobun build --env=stable
